messages.model_base: Base speech model (more accurate, for reminders)
messages.model_small: Small speech model (most accurate, slow on older computers)
messages.choice_small: Small: most accurate, slow on older computers
messages.page_help: Talk to Aruna (Ctrl+Alt+Backspace): for example "latest earthquake", "what time is it" or "remind me to take medicine tomorrow at 8". Your speech is recognised on this computer by whisper.cpp; it is never saved or sent anywhere. First download the tiny model below (the program comes with it). The base model makes reminders more accurate.
messages.page_headset: A headset is recommended: with speakers, the microphone can hear your screen reader. Hariku silences the screen reader and Hariku Voice while it listens. If you have to speak loudly, press Test microphone and say a sentence at your normal volume: Hariku measures your voice and the room and sets the microphone sensitivity for you.
messages.chk_listen_on_open: Start &listening as soon as Aruna opens
messages.status_ready: Voice Control is ready. Press Ctrl+Alt+Backspace and speak after the tone.
messages.status_not_ready: Download the tiny speech model to start; the program comes with it.
messages.nothing_selected: Select the program or a model first.
messages.busy: Another download is running. Wait for it, or cancel it.
messages.confirm_runtime: Download the speech recognition program, whisper.cpp, from GitHub? Size: {size}. It is released under the MIT license.
messages.confirm_model: Download the {name} from Hugging Face? Size: {size}.
messages.confirm_with_runtime: The speech recognition program, whisper.cpp ({size}, from GitHub), comes with it: {total} in all.
messages.confirm_small_slow: This model is slow on older computers: a short command can take 15 seconds or more.
messages.confirm_license: whisper.cpp and the Whisper models are released under the MIT license. Nothing you say is ever sent anywhere.
messages.confirm_remove: Remove {name} from this computer? You can download it again later.
messages.remove_failed: {name} could not be removed completely. Close Hariku and try again.
messages.err_offline: The server could not be reached. Check the internet connection.
messages.err_host: The download was sent to {host}, which Hariku doesn't trust, so it stopped.
messages.err_verify: The downloaded file didn't match its checksum, so it was deleted.
messages.err_extract: The program's zip file could not be unpacked.
messages.err_disk: The file could not be saved. Check the free space on the disk.
messages.err_unexpected: Something went wrong with Voice Control. The details are in the log.
messages.err_not_ready: Voice Control has no speech model yet. Download one in Preferences, Voice Control.
messages.err_no_speech: I didn't hear anything. Press Ctrl+Alt+Backspace and try again a bit closer to the microphone, or raise the microphone sensitivity in Preferences, Voice Control.
messages.err_too_noisy: It was too noisy to hear when you stopped speaking, so I stopped listening after {seconds} seconds. Next time, press Enter as soon as you finish, or lower the microphone sensitivity in Preferences, Voice Control.
messages.err_timeout: Recognising took too long. Try the tiny model in Preferences, Voice Control.
messages.err_engine: The speech recognition program didn't work. Try downloading it again in Preferences, Voice Control.
messages.mic_none: No microphone was found. Plug in a microphone or a headset and try again.
messages.mic_busy: Another program is using the microphone. Close it and try again.
messages.mic_blocked_device: Windows has the microphone turned off for this computer. Turn on "Allow access to the microphone on this device" in Windows Settings, Privacy, Microphone.
messages.mic_blocked_apps: Windows doesn't let apps use the microphone. Turn on "Allow apps to access your microphone" in Windows Settings, Privacy, Microphone.
messages.mic_blocked_desktop: Windows doesn't let desktop apps like Hariku use the microphone. Turn on "Let desktop apps access your microphone" in Windows Settings, Privacy, Microphone.
messages.mic_silent: The microphone gave only silence. Check that it isn't muted, and that "Let desktop apps access your microphone" is on in Windows Settings, Privacy, Microphone.
messages.mic_failed: The microphone could not be opened.
messages.mic_test_speak: After the tone, say a sentence at your normal volume.
messages.mic_test_running: The microphone test is already running.
messages.mic_test_busy: The microphone is busy. Try again after listening ends.
messages.calibrate_done: Your voice: {voice} dB, the room: {room} dB. Sensitivity set to {level}.
messages.calibrate_too_quiet: Your voice: {voice} dB, the room: {room} dB. Sensitivity set to {level}, but your voice is still too quiet. Raise the microphone level in Windows Settings, System, Sound, Input, Device properties, or use a headset microphone.
messages.calibrate_too_noisy: Your voice: {voice} dB, the room: {room} dB. Sensitivity set to {level}, but the room is too noisy for your voice. Use a headset microphone, or raise the microphone level in Windows Settings, System, Sound, Input, Device properties.
messages.calibrate_no_speech: I didn't hear you speak. The room: {room} dB. Press Test microphone and say a sentence after the tone. If you did speak, raise the microphone level in Windows Settings, System, Sound, Input, Device properties, or check that the microphone isn't muted.
